title: Redpath Museum
scope: The standing 1882 Redpath Museum on McGill University’s downtown campus, including the elevated limestone entrance, projecting side porticoes and semicircular glazed rear gallery.
limitations: The standing entrance, side porticoes and rounded rear gallery are modeled from the mapped footprint, an independently matched public-domain photograph, and published architectural facts.

Roof and gutter joints, stair elevations, metal details and the exact carved leaf and floral decoration are approximations. Modern banners, temporary works, neighboring buildings and interior exhibits are outside the model.
